itemListElement.name: Tactiq Alternatives for US Teams in 2026

mainEntity.name: What is the best alternative to Tactiq?

acceptedAnswer.text: Lynkk is the best alternative if you want follow-up work done, Fathom if you want free unlimited recording, and Notta if you want cheap transcription minutes and file uploads. Fireflies suits CRM-driven teams, and Google Meet's built-in notes suit English-only Workspace teams.

Yes. Tactiq's free plan includes 10 transcripts and 5 AI credits a month. Pro costs $8 per user per month billed yearly and removes the transcript limit. Unlimited AI credits start on the Team plan at $16.67 per user billed yearly, which matters if you use AI summaries often.

Tactiq is a widely used extension, and its Business plan adds SAML SSO and advanced data retention. Review the extension's permissions and your company's policy on browser extensions before installing. Also tell participants you are transcribing, since several US states require all parties to consent to recording.

Tactiq's main competitors are Otter.ai, Fireflies.ai, Fathom, Notta, Read AI, Google Meet's built-in notes and Lynkk. Each takes a different approach to capture and follow-up. Compare them on free limits, price per user and whether they capture meetings outside the browser.

mainEntity.name: Is there a Tactiq alternative for Zoom and Microsoft Teams?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Lynkk, Fathom, Fireflies, Otter and Read AI all work with Zoom and Microsoft Teams as well as Google Meet. Bot-based tools join from your calendar, so they work even when you are not running Chrome during the call.

mainEntity.name: Does any Tactiq alternative support Hindi?

acceptedAnswer.text: Lynkk supports Hindi and a Hinglish setting for mixed Hindi and English meetings. Google Meet's Take notes for me does not list Hindi among its 8 supported languages.
